build_qwen3_asr_model: build a Qwen3-ASR inference model for automatic speech recognition with vLLM
create_multimodal_audio_processor: create a multimodal processor that parses audio inputs and generates prompt replacements for audio tokens
run_transcription_generation: run transcription or translation generation from audio input with optional target language specification
test_speech_to_text_config: test speech-to-text configuration retrieval including max audio clip duration and sample rate
summarize_post_process_output: summarize raw model output by stripping language prefix and asr_text tags to extract clean transcription
